item.title: MAGA Congressman Claims “Muslims Don’t Belong in American Society”
item.description: Republican Representative Andy Ogles decided to write off an entire religious community in America on Monday.“Muslims don’t belong in American society,” Ogles posted on X. “Pluralism is a lie.”The Tennessee congressman has a long history of bigoted comments. item.title: Trump Admits He’s Totally Caved to Israel on the Iran War
item.description: The U.S. will only pull out of Iran when Israel decides it’s time to call it quits.That’s according to Donald Trump, who told The Times of Israel on Sunday that the decision to end the Iran war will be a “mutual” decision he makes with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.“I think it’s mutual … a little bit. We’ve been talking,” Trump said when asked if he alone would make the decision to end the war. “I’ll make a decision at the right time, but everything’s going to be taken into account.”

item.title: Pete Hegseth Blew Billions on Fruit Basket Stands, Chairs, and Crab
item.description: The Pentagon spent more money in September—the end of the 2025 fiscal year—than it had in any other year since 2008. But a good chunk of the budget wasn’t used for anything that could be considered a pertinent military expense.The Defense Department burned through $93 billion that month alone, signing checks left and right in order to dry up its congressionally allocated budget, according to a recent analysis by the government watchdog Open the Books.
